correctness.rationale: The space-time observation rank is exactly the span dimension of Laurent monomials z^j(z+z^-1)^s. The rational-field involution gives a quadratic extension with basis 1,z; the monic Dickson/Chebyshev B sequence has gcd(B_m,B_n)=B_gcd(m,n) by its addition and Cassini identities. This proves a single primitive polynomial syzygy with maximum degree k-g. All finite relations are multiples of it; counting those with degrees below t gives rank 3t-max(0,t-k+g) for all finite fields, h<k and t>=1. The Haar law is uniform on the exact linear image. The package verifies 13,464 finite exact ranks, 2,244 Laurent identities, 6,724 strong-divisibility instances and four exhaustive image distributions; the proof, not these finite diagnostics, supports the universal claim.
